# Kubernetes Python client
# https://github.com/kubernetes-client/python
kubernetes==28.1.0

# HTTP requests (for Keto REST API)
# https://requests.readthedocs.io/
requests==2.31.0

# gRPC client (for Keto gRPC API — preferred for production)
# https://grpc.io/docs/languages/python/
grpcio==1.59.0
grpcio-tools==1.59.0

# Ory Keto Python client (auto-generated from OpenAPI spec)
# https://github.com/ory/client-python
ory-client==1.5.1

# Structured logging
# https://www.structlog.org/
structlog==23.2.0

# Install:
#   pip install -r requirements.txt
#
# Or inside a container (no venv needed):
#   pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
#
# Python version: 3.11+
# Tested with: minikube v1.31.1, Kubernetes v1.28, Keto v0.11.1
